contract.goal: Build a fixture-backed task board with add, complete and filter actions plus accessible feedback. Add two tasks, complete one, filter completed: exactly one remains; invalid blank tasks are rejected.
contract.contributionFocus: Implement the required behavior from the explicit contract; show the smallest useful complete example.

scenarios.name: Initial Mount & Fixture Verification
scenarios.action: Mount fresh component with default fixture

scenarios.name: Add First Task
scenarios.expected: total=1, active=1, completed=0, feedback="Task "Synthesize React fundamentals" added."

scenarios.name: Add Second Task (Two tasks added)
scenarios.expected: total=2, active=2, completed=0, feedback="Task "Deliver final capstone project" added."
scenarios.actual: total=2, feedback="Task "Deliver final capstone project" added."

scenarios.name: Complete One Task
scenarios.action: Toggle complete on first task "Synthesize React fundamentals"
scenarios.expected: total=2, active=1, completed=1, feedback="Task "Synthesize React fundamentals" marked as completed."
scenarios.actual: active=1, completed=1, feedback="Task "Synthesize React fundamentals" marked as completed."

scenarios.name: Filter Completed (Contract: Exactly One Remains)
scenarios.expected: exactly 1 visible task remaining ("Synthesize React fundamentals")

scenarios.name: Filter Active
scenarios.expected: exactly 1 visible active task ("Deliver final capstone project")

scenarios.name: Rejection of Invalid Blank Task (Empty String "")
scenarios.expected: rejected, total=2, aria-invalid=true, role=alert, feedback="Error: Task title cannot be blank."
scenarios.actual: total=2, aria-invalid=true, role=alert, feedback="Error: Task title cannot be blank."

scenarios.name: Rejection of Invalid Blank Task (Whitespace Only "   ")
scenarios.actual: total=2, aria-invalid=true, feedback="Error: Task title cannot be blank."

scenarios.name: Contribution Focus: Contract Recovery & Reset to Fixture
scenarios.action: Valid submission resets error; Reset button restores initial fixture
scenarios.expected: total=0, aria-invalid=false, feedback="Task board reset to initial fixture."

scenarios.name: Runtime Health & Zero Error Audit
scenarios.action: Inspect console messages, page errors, and network request failures
scenarios.expected: 0 console errors, 0 page errors, 0 request failures
